Class QuadIter

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.CodeGen.QuadIter
public class QuadIter
extends java.lang.Object

An object of the class QuadIter (quadrant iterator) is typically used when generating arc output for machines tools that are restricted to processing arc quadrant data.
